description.zh: 如果为空查询当前账号及其托管子账号的数据，可传入托管子账号ID，明确查询该子账号数据。
description.en: The ID of the account whose data you want to query. If you do not specify this parameter, the data of the current Alibaba Cloud account and its Resource Access Management (RAM) users is queried. To query the data of a RAM user, specify the ID of the RAM user.

description.zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss；查询逻辑为不包括该时间；为空表示截止到当前时间
description.en: The end of the time range to query. The end is excluded from the time range. If you do not set this parameter, the end time is the current time. Specify the time in the format of yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss.

description.zh: 本次读取的最大数据记录数量。默认值：20，最大值：300。
description.en: The maximum number of entries to return. Default value: 20. The maximum value is 300.

description.zh: 分页token，首页查询时传空，查询结果中返回下一页token地址。当结果token为空时表示全部查完。
description.en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. You do not need to specify this parameter for the first request. You must specify the token that is obtained from the previous query as the value of NextToken. If NextToken is empty, no next page exists.

description.zh: MONTH：月维度； DAY：天维度； HOUR：小时维度；
description.en: The time granularity at which usage details are queried. Valid values: MONTH, DAY, and HOUR.

description.zh: 资源包类型。枚举值：RI：预留实例；SCU：存储容量单位包。
description.en: The type of deduction plan whose usage details are queried. Valid values: RI and SCU.

description.zh: 格式：yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss； 查询逻辑为包括该时间
description.en: The beginning of the time range to query. The beginning is included in the time range. Specify the time in the yyyy-MM-dd HH:mm:ss format.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun bssopenapi describe-resource-usage-detail --start-period 2021-01-01_00:00:00 --end-period 2021-01-02_00:00:00 --period-type HOUR --next-token eyJwYWdlTnVtIjoyLCJwYWdlU2l6ZSI6MTB9 --max-results 200 --bill-owner-id 123745698925000 --resource-type RI --api-version 2017-12-14 --region cn-hangzhou
